mentions.note: won inter-club cross country race c.1926
one-time cross-country champion; as a Sparkhill Harrier won the Midlands Everill Cup and ran in the 1924 Olympic Games; won Belgrave 10 miles Championship 1927 and 1928

share.d: Arthur Clark in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1966–1969: 4 mentions in 3 issues and 2 race results.
